sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2026 of 2023

Applicant :- Vivek Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. A.C.S. / Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home Govt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Manuvendra Singh,Sachin Pratap Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Manuvendra Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Jayant Singh
Tomar, the learned Additional Government Advocate-I appearing on behalf of the State and perused
the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing
Case Crime No.311 of 2021, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station
Sarojini Nagar, District Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 13.07.2021 against eleven persons, not including the applicant, stating that some imposter had executed a sale deed in respect of the informant's house in favour of the named accused, Kapil Singh.
Although the applicant was not named in the FIR, he has been implicated subsequently as he is an employee working in the Lucknow Development Authority consequent to the sale deed in question.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application, it has been contended that the applicant is innocent, he has no criminal history and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
Both witnesses of execution of the sale deed Anil Kumar Sharma and Harpal Singh Chaddha Vivek Srivastava vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. A.C.S. / Prin. ...

entities.text: Harpal Singh Chaddha Vivek Srivastava vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. A.C.S. / Prin
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: have already been granted anticipatory bail by means of the orders dated 24.07.2023 and 03.01.2023 passed by this court in anticipatory Bail Application Nos.666 of 2023 and 2174 of 2022 respectively.

entities.text: Bail Application Nos.666 of 2023 and 2174 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is not named in the FIR and he has been implicated solely for the reason that he has carried out mutation proceedings on the basis of registered sale-deed produced before him and that the applicant being an employee of the L.D.A., there appears to be no reasonable apprehension of his involvement in commission of the offence, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
